name: Asakura Wakaba
source:
Although he is an ordinary employee, he made a fierce attack on Yoriyoi, the madonna of the company, and successfully won her heart.
Because he lacks self-confidence, he looks up to Yoruyo, who speaks clearly, as his lover.
He is now an ordinary employee, but his dream is to have a child with Yoruyo and to support her someday.
He is still happy now that he has forgotten about Takumi. ......
